title: Coordinate SDK & API debut for Function Calling + Structured Streaming — release orchestration & samples
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Overview: Coordinate the cross-team launch of SDK surface and API changes that introduce Function Calling v2 (typed function signatures, improved error semantics) and Structured Output streaming (chunked JSON+schema, out-of-order partial payloads). Goal is a single coordinated public release that includes SDKs (Python, JavaScript, Go), updated REST/HTTP examples, end-to-end samples, migration guides, and a consolidated release notes artifact for Marketing & Support.

Scope:
- SDK updates: Python (redwood-python) 1.6.0, JS (redwood-js) 0.9.0, Go (redwood-go) 0.3.0 with first-class function-calling helpers and streaming parsers.
- API surface: /v2/generate additions for function_schema, streaming_schema markers, back-compat headers.
- Docs: API reference pages, quickstarts, migration guides, FAQ, and a canonical sample app repo demonstrating multi-language clients calling a function-oriented assistant and consuming streaming structured output.
- Release notes + changelog: single PM-authored release notes doc and a one-page engineer-facing changelog for Dedicated/Private release engineering.

Success metrics:
- Launch checklist complete and signed off by Engineering, Design, Security, and Docs.
- 95% of automated SDK tests pass in final release candidate; no critical regressions.
- First-week adoption: >= 30 unique orgs try function-calling or structured streaming from free tier or trial.
- < 5 high-severity issues reported in first 7 days.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All three SDKs published to package registries with consistent API and samples. 2) Docs pages live and linked from SDK README. 3) Release notes finalized and staged in Marketing/Support channels. 4) Post-launch monitoring dashboard configured with customer-facing SLOs and error-rate alerts. 5) Rollback plan tested in staging.
checklist: Finalize API contract (ENG/Platform) and publish OpenAPI snippet
Draft migration guide for existing function-calling users
Add structured streaming example to console quickstart
Create sample app repo with Python/JS/Go clients
Write release notes and one-page changelog
Compatibility test matrix for Dedicated/Private deployments
Prepare Support playbook and triage runbook
